lines.text: This month, we’re running a space exhibit.
Moon Stone, huh?\c\nWhat’s so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.

It has been decades since mankind stood on
the moon...and now, we’re following the dream
of standing on that faraway red planet!\c
News about space always makes me so excited!
I want [VAR INDEF_ART(0002)][VAR POKNAME(0002)]!\nIt’s so cute!\c\nDaddy, can you please get one for me?
Yeah, I’ll get you [VAR INDEF_ART(0002)][VAR POKNAME(0002)] soon—\nI promise!
I think you and [VAR POKNAME(0002)] are going to\nbecome fast friends.\c\nI couldn’t take that away...
Hey, your [VAR POKNAME(0002)]...\c\nNo, it’s too attached to you. I could never tear\napart such a bond.
It looks like an old space shuttle.
It says it’s an object that fell on Mt. Moon,\nthought to be a Moon Stone.
A 3-D hologram! And it has a title:\nA Map of the Universe.
They look to be pieces of a meteor.
It seems to show the origin of the universe.
You saw a beautiful crystal when you\nlooked into the microscope.
